correctness.rationale: Classical secant degree via Thom–Porteous is binom(n-r,r). The endpoint projection center is disjoint: first nonzero middle x_j forces nonzero anti-triangular (r+1)-minor. Hence its finite morphism degree equals secant degree. Every other coordinate center contains an endpoint unit vector e_j on secant; projection through e_j has strict loss by positive Hilbert–Samuel multiplicity, and later projection cannot increase degree. Reed–Tsakiris uniformity supplies generic finiteness. Independent rank-two length-five Hankel determinant has missing-coordinate degrees [1,2,3,2,1], verifying small case only.
